title: Production Recovery Kernel canonical durability and fixed Admin authority closure

phases.objective: Make canonical durable-store qualification authoritative at the Recovery Kernel and fixed Admin System Tool consumer boundaries, degrade unready evidence stores to memory-only diagnostics, preserve explicit-null mutation fail-close, and require canonical mutation-grade Recovery storage before Production live mutation authority can be exposed.

e2e_journeys.actor: Fixed Admin System Tool Recovery caller
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Fixed Admin Recovery reads use only qualified evidence authority, consequential control/execution uses only explicit mutation authority, explicit mutationRecoveryStore=null never falls back to the legacy alias, and an observed unready evidence store is treated as memory-only rather than durable.
steps: Qualify evidence and mutation stores through recoveryDurableStoreContract.js rather than method-shape-only local validators.
Route recovery_kernel_call through readOnlyRecoveryStore when that dependency is explicitly present.
Route approval/control and execute-approved operations through mutationRecoveryStore when that dependency is explicitly present.
Reject consequential capabilities on the read-only fixed Admin bridge.
Preserve explicit mutationRecoveryStore=null as authoritative fail-closed state without fallback to recoveryStore.
Observe getReadiness when exposed by the Recovery Control Store and remove unready evidence authority from the durable path.
Normalize database inspection and durable readback claims so inspection-grade and mutation-grade are separate booleans.
Require canonical mutation-grade storage before any Production live composition may expose mutation_authority_available=true.
Keep provider, database, migration, grant, Production deploy, workflow-dispatch and secret mutation outside this change.
assertions: Evidence-grade durability never implies mutation-grade authority.
A method-shape-only store that omits canonical independence, schema-auto-apply or payload-integrity guarantees cannot produce durable proof.
Fixed Admin recovery_kernel_call selects the explicit readOnlyRecoveryStore and does not touch a legacy recoveryStore alias when the explicit boundary exists.
Fixed Admin execute-approved selects mutationRecoveryStore only, and explicit null mutation authority remains fail-closed.
Approval challenge creation is treated as control-plane state mutation and cannot run through the evidence-only projection.
Observed Recovery Control Store readiness=false causes memory-only/degraded diagnostics and inspection_durable=false rather than false durable evidence.
Role-selection provenance can become durable_full_inspection only when the store passed canonical inspection qualification and remained ready for the request.
Production live activation cannot expose mutation authority without canonical isMutationGradeRecoveryStore qualification.
No provider call, database mutation, migration apply, grant mutation, Production deploy, ruleset mutation or secret read is authorized by this closure.
